evaluations.prompt: Use Metrix to measure my vector_add HIP kernel in vector_add.hip on this GPU: its run time, HBM bandwidth, and L2 cache hit rate. Save the raw profile to results.json and tell me whether it is memory bound.
expected_behavior: Builds vector_add.hip with hipcc and profiles the resulting binary with Metrix, collecting memory bandwidth and L2 hit rate metrics
Reports the kernel time, HBM bandwidth, and L2 hit rate using the numbers Metrix printed or saved, and concludes from them whether the kernel is memory bound
unexpected_behavior: Presents a time, bandwidth, or hit rate that Metrix did not measure as if Metrix had measured it

evaluations.prompt: Use Metrix to time my vector_add HIP kernel in vector_add.hip over 10 replays and tell me the average; I only need timing, not hardware counters. Save the result to timing.json.
expected_behavior: Uses Metrix's timing-only mode (no hardware counters) with 10 replays and saves the result to timing.json
Reports the average vector_add kernel time from the Metrix output
unexpected_behavior: Collects hardware counter metrics, or reports a time that does not appear in the Metrix output

evaluations.prompt: Measure the memory bandwidth and L2 cache hit rate of a naive HIP GEMM kernel on this AMD GPU so I can tell whether it is memory bound.
Get per-kernel GPU timings for one training step of a small PyTorch MLP on this AMD GPU, and tell me which kernels have poor memory coalescing.
Profile my CUDA kernel on an NVIDIA H100 with Nsight Compute and report achieved occupancy.
Profile my C++ program's CPU hotspots with perf and show me a flame graph.
